infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sweep uses the camera to help you inspect a room for visible camera-lens reflections.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Sweep scans nearby Bluetooth advertisements for unfamiliar devices.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Sweep to use your camera during a room inspection.
